item.title: Show HN: CineCLI – Browse and torrent movies directly from your terminal
item.description:
📝 🎬 CineCLI Browse, inspect, and launch movie torrents directly from your terminal. ✨ Features 🔍 Search movies from YTS 🎥 View detailed movie information 🧲 Launch magnet links directly into your torrent client 📦 Download. torrent 🧭 Interactive mode (recommended for exploration) cinecli interactive Search → select movie → choose torrent Manual selection by design (safe & explicit) ⚙️ How magnet launching works CineCLI delegates magnet handling to your OS.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/eyeblech/cinecli

item.title: Call of Duty co-creator Vince Zampella dies in California car crash
item.description:
📝 Zampella created Call of Duty with his long time collaborators Jason West and Grant Collier in 2003. The Call of Duty franchise was not his only success. At Electronic Arts, Zampella worked on Battlefield 6, which is seen as a direct competitor to Call of Duty.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx25rled0ylo
